screen.title: Announcement: Club funding forms
screen.prompt: Listen to an announcement in the student center.

audio.text: Hello, club leaders. Funding forms for next term are due this Friday at five p.m. You can pick up a form at the Student Activities desk or download it from our website. Please list everything your club plans to buy. Late forms will not be accepted. Thank you.

why.en: Audience: it begins "Hello, club leaders". C misuses "Student Activities desk", which is where the forms are.
why.tr: Dinleyici kitlesi: duyuru "Hello, club leaders" diye başlıyor. C formların bulunduğu yer olan "Student Activities desk" ifadesini yanlış kullanıyor.
why.es: Destinatarios: empieza con "Hello, club leaders". C usa mal "Student Activities desk", que es donde están los formularios.

questions.stem: What will happen to forms that arrive after Friday?
options: They will be read next term
They must be sent by email

why.en: Detail: "Late forms will not be accepted". A misuses "next term", which is when the money will be spent.
why.tr: Ayrıntı: "Late forms will not be accepted". A paranın harcanacağı dönemi anlatan "next term" ifadesini yanlış kullanıyor.
why.es: Detalle: "Late forms will not be accepted". A usa mal "next term", que es cuando se gastará el dinero.
